topic_1.content:
# Welcome to Your Personal Study Note

This is your personal space for learning and note-taking.

## Features:
- **Rich Text Editing**: Write notes with markdown support
- **Categories & Tags**: Organize topics with categories and tags
- **Pin Notes**: Pin important notes to the top of your list
- **Archive**: Archive old notes to keep your list clean
- **Templates**: Use pre-made templates for common note types
- **Note Linking**: Link to other notes using [[Note Title]] syntax
- **Search**: Find topics quickly by title or content
- **Images & Links**: Add images and hyperlinks to your notes
- **Undo/Redo**: Use Cmd/Ctrl+Z to undo, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Cmd/Ctrl+B for bold, Cmd/Ctrl+I for italic, Cmd/Ctrl+K for links
- **Export**: Download notes as Markdown, PDF, or Word

## How to Use:
1. Click the **+ New Topic** button to create a new study topic
2. Select a topic from the left sidebar to view or edit
3. Use markdown formatting or the toolbar for rich text
4. Press Cmd/Ctrl+S to save your changes
5. Click any link to preview it on the right!

## Note Linking:
Link to other notes like this: [[Getting Started]]

Happy studying!
